## Summary

Implemented Plan 2026-05-22-004 F001 (`dontpanic capabilities setup <id> --print-steps`) as a pure planning surface — no commands execute. I added `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/capabilities_setup.py` with `resolve_capability()` (closest-match suggestion on unknown ids), `render_print_steps()` (ordered render of `setup_steps[]` with `[automatable]`/`[human-required]` tags, command templates, verify probes, and pending-probe readiness chips sourced from V0b `capabilities status`), and an argparse-backed `main()` that requires `--print-steps`. Wired it into `cli.py` so `dontpanic capabilities setup ...` dispatches to the new module while `capabilities status` still routes to the existing handler; also updated the top-level help.

Covered acceptance with 17 tests in `tests/test_capabilities_setup_cli_f001.py` — Firebase happy path (all 9 steps in order), Linear happy path (4 steps), human-required reason text, automatable command_template + verify_probe rendering, empty `setup_steps[]` notice, unknown-id closest-match (`firebase-dashboarrd` → `firebase-dashboard`), CLI `--print-steps` requirement, and a strict guard that no `setup_steps[].command_template` payload is ever spawned as a subprocess. All 17 pass; spot-checked 42 adjacent capability tests to confirm no regression.
